name: Multi-slot re-ranking simulator
description: In this paper, we propose a generic model-based re-ranking framework, MultiSlot ReRanker, which simultaneously optimizes relevance, diversity, and freshness. Specifically, our Sequential Greedy Algorithm (SGA) is efficient enough (linear time complexity) for large-scale production recommendation engines. It achieved a lift of $+6\%$ to $ +10\%$ offline Area Under the receiver operating characteristic Curve (AUC) which is mainly due to explicitly modeling mutual influences among items of a list, and leveraging the second pass ranking scores of multiple objectives.
